title: USA CONCEALED CARRY RECIPROCITY
source: State Attorney General & State Police reciprocity lists (public records)
disclaimer: Not legal advice. Verify with state authorities before traveling.

AL.permitlessRule: Adults 19 and older who may legally have a handgun.
AL.minAge: Adults 19 and older who may legally have a handgun
AL.inform: No duty to volunteer it, but show your permit and ID if an officer asks.
